name: wykop-mcp
description: Wykop (social): read_comments, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_wykop_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WYKOP_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_wykop_app_key.description: Wykop application key (appkey) issued for the app.

platform_mcp_wykop_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WYKOP_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_wykop_app_secret.description: Secret paired with the app key.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: GET /entries/{entryId}/comments (Mikroblog - Komentarz) with the application JWT: page and limit ('Limit obiektów na stronie', 1-50, default 25). post_id is a microblog entry id; created_at is 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS]' (Warsaw time); votes are in raw.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: GET /entries/{entryId} 'Zwraca wpis z mikrobloga'; metrics are the entry's votes.up / votes.down and comments.count.
